title: Wild Steelbloom
wikitext:
'''Wild Steelbloom''' is an [[Herb]] that can be gathered with [[Herbalism]] (115), or can be bought in limited quantities from selected [[Vendors]].

==Source==
Wild Steelbloom can be found on steep hills. It is known for being unusually difficult to reach, usually requiring more navigation around steep slopes in order to reach it. It can be found in the following zones - [[Alterac Mountains]], [[Arathi Highlands]], [[Ashenvale]], [[Badlands]], [[The Barrens]], [[Desolace]], [[Duskwood]], [[Hillsbrad Foothills]], [[Stonetalon Mountains]], [[Stranglethorn Vale]], [[Thousand Needles]] and [[Wetlands]].
